desc: Build rooted adjacency from undirected edges storing (neighbor, length).
Implement iterative DFS carrying depth, prefix-sum-by-depth, last-seen map, and parent boundary m0.
Compute per-node maximal candidate: length = pref[depth] - pref[m0], nodes = depth-m0+1.
Aggregate best as (max length, then min nodes) with best initialized (0,1); tie-break updates nodes on strict length tie.
Correctly save/restore last-seen and prefix-sum state on backtrack via explicit enter/exit stack markers.
Validate on Example 1 [6,2], Example 2 [0,1], all-equal-values, and positive-edge chain cases (manually verified).
